verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say the Postman CLI (and Newman) runs collections from the command line with built-in reporters, including test collections in CI/CD pipelines, and that scripts can perform API tests. That covers running a whole collection as an automated test suite with a report. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the pass/fail report format and outcome semantics, and independent hands-on corroboration of collection runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an entire collection as an automated test suite with a pass/fail report

citations.quote: Run and manage collections with extensive configuration options and built-in reporters.
You can also use the Postman CLI to run test collections as part of your continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
Newman allows you to run and test a Postman Collections directly from the command-line.
Perform API tests, add dynamic parameters, pass data between requests, and more.
